"""
Project Title: Video Frame Prediction with ConvLSTM and Spatio-Temporal Transformer (ai-ml-ds-ConvLSTMTransVid2025)
File Name: video_frame_prediction_with_convlstm_transformer.py

Short Description:
Implements a hybrid ConvLSTM + Transformer model in Keras to perform next-frame prediction on synthetic moving shapes videos.
Generates dummy moving-square sequences, trains ConvLSTM layers to extract spatio-temporal features, applies a Transformer encoder
over time to capture long-range dependencies, and decodes to predict the next frame.

Dataset: Synthetic 32×32 grayscale videos of moving squares generated on the fly.
"""

import os  # type: ignore
import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import tensorflow as tf  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model, Input  # type: ignore

# ----------------------------
# 1. Hyperparameters & Setup
# ----------------------------
SEQ_LEN: int = 10           # type: int = input sequence length
PRED_STEPS: int = 1         # type: int = predict this many future frames
H: int = 32                 # type: int = frame height
W: int = 32                 # type: int = frame width
C: int = 1                  # type: int = channels
BATCH_SIZE: int = 32        # type: int = batch size
EPOCHS: int = 20            # type: int = training epochs
D_MODEL: int = 256          # type: int = transformer model dim
N_HEADS: int = 4            # type: int = transformer heads
D_FF: int = 512             # type: int = transformer feed-forward dim
LR: float = 1e-3            # type: float = learning rate
LOG_DIR: str = "./logs_video_pred"
os.makedirs(LOG_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# ----------------------------
# 2. Synthetic Data Generator
# ----------------------------
def generate_batch(batch_size: int = BATCH_SIZE) -> tuple:
    """
    Creates batch of sequences: moving square on black background.
    Returns:
        X: np.ndarray of shape (batch, SEQ_LEN, H, W, C)
        Y: np.ndarray of shape (batch, PRED_STEPS, H, W, C)
    """
    X: np.ndarray = np.zeros((batch_size, SEQ_LEN, H, W, C), dtype="float32")
    Y: np.ndarray = np.zeros((batch_size, PRED_STEPS, H, W, C), dtype="float32")
    for i in range(batch_size):
        # random square initial pos and velocity
        size = np.random.randint(4, 8)
        x0, y0 = np.random.randint(0, H-size), np.random.randint(0, W-size)
        vx, vy = np.random.choice([-1,1])*np.random.uniform(0.5,1.5), np.random.choice([-1,1])*np.random.uniform(0.5,1.5)
        frames = []
        x, y = x0, y0
        for t in range(SEQ_LEN+PRED_STEPS):
            img = np.zeros((H, W), dtype="float32")
            xi, yi = int(x), int(y)
            img[xi:xi+size, yi:yi+size] = 1.0
            frames.append(img[...,None])
            x += vx; y += vy
            # bounce
            if x<0 or x+size>H: vx *= -1; x = np.clip(x,0,H-size)
            if y<0 or y+size>W: vy *= -1; y = np.clip(y,0,W-size)
        seq = np.stack(frames,axis=0)
        X[i] = seq[:SEQ_LEN]
        Y[i] = seq[SEQ_LEN:SEQ_LEN+PRED_STEPS]
    return X, Y

# ----------------------------
# 3. Transformer Encoder Block
# ----------------------------
def transformer_encoder_block(x: tf.Tensor) -> tf.Tensor:
    attn = layers.MultiHeadAttention(N_HEADS, key_dim=D_MODEL//N_HEADS)(x, x)
    attn = layers.Dropout(0.1)(attn)
    x1 = layers.LayerNormalization()(x + attn)
    ffn = layers.Dense(D_FF, activation="relu")(x1)
    ffn = layers.Dense(D_MODEL)(ffn)
    ffn = layers.Dropout(0.1)(ffn)
    return layers.LayerNormalization()(x1 + ffn)

# ----------------------------
# 4. Build Model
# ----------------------------
# Inputs
inp_seq = Input(shape=(SEQ_LEN, H, W, C), name="input_sequence")

# Spatio-temporal feature extraction via ConvLSTM
x = layers.ConvLSTM2D(64, 3, padding="same", return_sequences=True, activation="tanh")(inp_seq)
x = layers.ConvLSTM2D(D_MODEL, 3, padding="same", return_sequences=True, activation="tanh")(x)

# Flatten spatial dims, permute for transformer
b, t, h, w, d = tf.unstack(tf.shape(x))
x_flat = layers.Reshape((SEQ_LEN, h*w*d))(x)  # shape (b, t, h*w*d)

# Linear projection to D_MODEL
x_proj = layers.Dense(D_MODEL)(x_flat)

# Transformer layers
for _ in range(2):
    x_proj = transformer_encoder_block(x_proj)

# Take last time-step embedding
x_last = x_proj[:, -1, :]  # shape (b, D_MODEL)

# Decode to next-frame via dense and reshape+conv
y = layers.Dense(h*w*64, activation="relu")(x_last)
y = layers.Reshape((h, w, 64))(y)
y = layers.Conv2DTranspose(32, 3, padding="same", activation="relu")(y)
y = layers.Conv2DTranspose(16, 3, padding="same", activation="relu")(y)
out_frame = layers.Conv2D(1, 1, activation="sigmoid", name="pred_frame")(y)
out_seq = layers.Reshape((PRED_STEPS, H, W, C))(out_frame[...,None])  # shape (b,1,H,W,1)

model = Model(inputs=inp_seq, outputs=out_seq)
model.compile(optimizer=tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LR), loss="mse", metrics=["mae"])

# ----------------------------
# 5. Training Loop
# ----------------------------
for epoch in range(1, EPOCHS+1):
    Xb, Yb = generate_batch()
    loss, mae = model.train_on_batch(Xb, Yb)
    if epoch % 5 == 0:
        print(f"Epoch {epoch}/{EPOCHS} - Loss: {loss:.4f}, MAE: {mae:.4f}")

# ----------------------------
# 6. Example Use Cases
# ----------------------------
X_test, Y_test = generate_batch(4)
Y_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Print shapes and example pixel values
for i in range(2):
    print(f"Example {i}: true sum={Y_test[i].sum():.1f}, pred sum={Y_pred[i].sum():.1f}")

# ----------------------------
# 7. Save Model
# ----------------------------
model.save(os.path.join(LOG_DIR, "video_pred_model.h5"))

Key Learnings & Research Areas:

  • ConvLSTM2D for spatio-temporal feature extraction
  • Transformer encoder over time dimension to capture long-range dependencies
  • Synthetic video generation for moving objects
  • Keras Functional API with custom training loop

This hybrid model pushes beyond plain CNN/RNN approaches, integrating spatio-temporal recurrence and global attention for robust video prediction. Continuous improvement: add multi-step forecasting, perceptual losses, or integrate with real-world traffic camera data for advanced applications.🚀😊
